# Fitz

Fitz is a local-only strength training card. It runs as an installable web app on iPhone.

## What it contains

- Six training days, five lifts each, taken from a personal spreadsheet.
- Six rungs: one rung is one pass through the six days. Weight and set counts scale from the rung 1 numbers.
- Per-set logging with a five-point recovery check, kept in IndexedDB on the device.
- An exercise bank weighted toward a functional trainer and a barbell.

## Notes

No account, no sync, no network requests after install.
